display_long_description:
# BRKER is a free mixed reality basketball experience for Meta Quest, bringing arcade action to your real-world court.

Pick up a REAL basketball, enable HAND tracking, and ROOM-scale boundary, and navigate through high-speed obstacle courses in your living room, the gym, or shaded outdoor spaces.

[media]

Forget about pressing buttons; this is authentic ball handling, physical movement, and real-time reactions driven by mixed reality.

[media]

Evade obstacles, snag bonus items, and rack up points with dunks. Your movement speed is tied directly to your dribbling pace.

By merging the intensity of arcade play with genuine athletic motion, BRKER creates a unique environment for both athletes and gamers.

[media]

Dodge obstacles, unlock new levels, collect bonuses, and react in real time as the game builds your basketball control, awareness, and decision-making.

FEATURES

🏀 Physical basketball required
Integrate your own ball for a truly tactile gameplay experience.

🖐 Advanced hand tracking
Ditch the controllers and interact with the game using natural movements.

⚡ High-energy arcade gameplay
React and score as you survive challenges that scale in difficulty.

🏠 Versatile play areas
Transform any safe, shaded space—from home to the gym—into a playable arena.

📈 Unlockable progression
Discover new interactive levels and sharpen your performance with every session.

🔥 Skill-based training
Enhance your agility, reaction time, and vision while playing through dynamic worlds.
